ui.chat.composer_media.recording.note: Status beside the recording dot; shrink-0, so it must not wrap or truncate. maxCells is an advisory translation target, not measured fit.

ui.chat.composer_media.confirms.tone: lowercase verb; no capital or trailing punctuation
ui.chat.composer_media.confirms.note: Follows a separately rendered Enter keycap. Keep a short lowercase verb; maxCells is advisory, not measured fit.

ui.chat.composer_media.cancels.tone: lowercase verb; no capital or trailing punctuation
ui.chat.composer_media.cancels.note: Follows a separately rendered Esc keycap. Keep a short lowercase verb; maxCells is advisory, not measured fit.

ui.chat.composer_media.pasted_type.note: Keep {mimeType} verbatim: technical values include application/pdf. Word order may change around the placeholder. The 100px tile caption truncates; keep translated prose short but do not truncate or translate the MIME identifier itself.

ui.chat.composer_media.pasted_file.note: Fallback when the pasted data URI has no name or MIME type. A 100px tile caption may truncate; maxCells is advisory, not measured fit.

ui.chat.composer_media.preview_failed.tone: short neutral failure phrase, sentence case
ui.chat.composer_media.preview_failed.note: Media decode failure tooltip. File-bridge failures remain owned by the shared hook; maxCells is advisory, not measured fit.

ui.chat.composer_media.remove_attachment.role: remove control tooltip and accessible name
ui.chat.composer_media.remove_attachment.note: Tooltip and accessible name of the attachment remove button. maxCells is an advisory translation target, not measured fit.
